title: La crisis de 1929
goal: Read how the October 1929 Wall Street crash triggered bank runs, mass unemployment, and a collapse in American lending that would soon reach economies worldwide.

items: Explain what happened on "jueves negro," October 24, 1929.
Describe what millions of people did in the days that followed.
State what had happened to U.S. industrial production by 1932.
Explain what American banks stopped doing almost immediately.
Use acabar de + infinitive to mark an action that had just finished.
